summary:
Completed Phase 7 for session-gateway. Added `renovate.json`, a trusted-main weekly/manual dependency-submission workflow, `docs/dependency-automation.md`, and a README link. The workflow uses basic caching, separately scopes package-read and submission tokens, preflights `spring-platform` and `service-web`, and runs the build before submission so unresolved configurations cannot yield a silently partial graph. No dependencies, application code, or build inputs changed.

Validation passed under Node 24: strict Renovate schema validation, actionlint, documentation/link checks, and diff checks. Renovate extracted 39 occurrences across eight files using Gradle, wrapper, Dockerfile, and Actions managers, including both internal coordinates. Credential-free lookup returned 45 candidate branches; the sole diagnostic requires GitHub authentication and is deferred.

The official local graph generator completed but produced only 87 build/tool coordinates and no WebFlux, Security, Reactor, Netty, Lettuce, or internal coordinates. Dependency insight confirmed HTTP 401 resolving `service-web` 0.0.16. Authenticated build/resolution, complete reactive graph verification, hosted submission, published-preset resolution, bot-PR CI, and Dependabot evidence remain pending Phase 12 as documented. Tomcat is explicitly excluded from the reactive service’s acceptance expectations.
